newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Malaysia sets January Tapis price at $26.23/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia sets January Tapis price at $26.23/bbl.

text.p: Malaysian state oil company Petronas has raised its January-lifting Tapis crude oil price to $26.23 per barrel, up 79 cents from $25.44 in December, traders said on Tuesday.
For February, Petronas has set a premium of 70 cents per barrel for term crude oil sales, up from 60 cents in January.

Labuan was set at a fixed differential of Tapis plus 15 cents and Miri was set at Tapis plus 10 cents, in line with new differentials set for the first half of 1997. Bintulu differential was set at Tapis less 40 cents.
The price of January Dulang crude was set at $25.66 per barrel, up $1.11 from $24.55 per barrel for December.
Terengganu condensate for January was set at $25.03 per barrel while Bintulu condensate was set at $25.13.
JAN DEC NOV OCT SEPT AUGUST
